line: Write down one thing you love about your life right now.
paragraph: A woman in Melbourne rented the same house for twenty-three years. Her landlord was a self-made millionaire who had begun giving away his money in his later years. One day he gave her the house she had been living in. She was shocked. He saw himself as a philanthropist, and this was how he lived it.

seed.summary: Landlords get a bad rap, often unfairly, but now from Melbourne comes the story of one who gave a long-term tenant the home she was renting.
